scope: post-hoc cross-run endpoint analysis; no new training or inference

method.interval: paired row bootstrap percentile 95%; does not measure training-seed variation

references.name: accepted pure-2D GPTrans-T Kaggle1 same-platform prior job
accepted pure-2D GPTrans-T Kaggle2 P100 V4 prior job

comparison_limitations: Both pure-2D references were trained in separate jobs; the Kaggle2 job used P100 rather than T4.
The V5 strict mechanism gate does not permit feature_identity as a declared intervention; distance geometry changes feature identity.
The geometry run lacks the per-epoch live-development metric required by strict V5 trace comparison.
The row bootstrap is conditional on these fitted models and cannot establish training-seed robustness.
This comparison was not the frozen angle-versus-distance decision gate and cannot promote distance_only.
